name: airscope_city_domains
description: Simplified, hand-digitised analysis domains for AirScope. They approximate the built-up urban extent of each city for modelling purposes and are NOT administrative boundaries. Coordinates are WGS84 (lon, lat).
license: Created for AirScope; released with the project. Approximate geometry - do not use for legal or administrative purposes.

properties.name: Islamabad
properties.domain_note: Approximate analysis domain covering Islamabad's urban sectors and the adjoining Rawalpindi urban area, which share one airshed. Hand-digitised simplification, not an administrative boundary.

properties.name: Lahore
properties.domain_note: Approximate analysis domain covering Lahore's main built-up area on both banks of the Ravi. Hand-digitised simplification, not an administrative boundary.

properties.name: Karachi
properties.domain_note: Approximate analysis domain covering Karachi's main built-up area from Keamari to Landhi and Malir, bounded by the coastline to the south. Hand-digitised simplification, not an administrative boundary.
